scope: Explicit recovery of all four SOLID/TRACE OCS corners after exactly one legacy applyExtrusion call. DXF output only. No default writer, reader, consumer ABI or class layout change; 3DFACE remains excluded.

authority.oda: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §§20.4.35–36: common elevation, four 2RD corners and extrusion for SOLID/TRACE.
authority.finding: TRACE corners are OCS; 3DFACE corners are WCS. Independent observed SOLID behavior agrees with OCS for this one source.

physical.source: Locally authored from scratch with ezdxf 1.4.5 R2010: one SOLID, one TRACE, normal (0,1,0), four corners at elevation 3 and thickness 0.5. ODA File Converter 27.1.0 saved it as AC1024 DWG, then reopened and saved DXF. Scratch paths only; no drawing fixture is added.

observation: For SOLID, ODA and native applyExt=false have OCS corner (1,2,3) and ezdxf WCS corner (-1,3,2). Native applyExt=true followed by the unmodified ordinary writer has OCS (-1,3,2), interpreted as WCS (1,2,3); TRACE has the same misplacement. The explicit helper corrects the selected-record output. ezdxf independently confirmed all four OCS corners, all four WCS corners, thickness and extrusion of both corrected entities match the ODA DXF; selected-record output is not a whole-document conversion.
implementation: Separate exact-runtime-type TRACE and SOLID free-function overloads validate finite input, nonzero finite normal and finite inverse-projected points, then publish an independently transformed copy only on success. Explicit caller knows the source was transformed exactly once; haveExtrusion=false is a no-op. Exact runtime type and entity tag reject derived objects including 3DFACE. Input may alias output, and errors do not change output.

validation.focused: ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R ^libdxfrw_dxf_legacy_extrusion$ --output-on-failure: 1/1 passed. ASCII and Binary DXF tests cover both entities with tilted, negative-Z and arbitrary-axis-threshold normals; all four corners and normal/thickness, no-op, nonunit normal, alias, invalid input, derived/3DFACE refusal, sentinel preservation and same-writer retry. Existing CIRCLE/ARC and selected AC1024 DWG controls also run in this selector.
validation.independent: ezdxf 1.4.5 compared selected corrected DXF to ODA DXF for both entities and all four OCS/WCS corners, extrusion and thickness; all matched. One source normal only; scratch source and binaries are ephemeral.

limits: The physical producer test exercises one AC1024 source and selected DXF output, not whole-document conversion, other producers, native rendering or every normal.
The helper does not infer whether input was actually transformed or edited afterwards.
DWG writing with the helper output is not independently qualified. No raw geometry file is committed.
